'''Porro Dolphe''' was a pilot in the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces's]] [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] as Bravo Two in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

==Biography==
Dolphe grew up in a small town outside [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] before he decided to do volunteer work as a pilot. He later took part in the attack on the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Naboo Space Battle]], which he survived. Porro Dolphe then participated in the celebration outside Theed after the battle.

[[22 BBY/Legends|Ten years]] later, he was selected by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]] to escort [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] in her flight to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], which ended in an assassination attempt on her life. Although knocked down by the blast, he was quick to his feet and swiftly established a perimeter around the other survivors.

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']], Porro Dolphe was portrayed by [[Benedict Taylor]], the adoptive brother of [[Femi Taylor]], who played [[Oola/Legends|Oola]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']].
